notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718379/7488ed0e3a719e8e2ff810b87bad267cc28160ab.png[/img]

Hi all,

YJM Games just launched a brand new VR game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/769640/Lordian_Karma/?beta=0]Lordian: Karma[/url].
It is a action defense VR games that can be played solo or with your friends in multiplayer mode.

To celebrate the launch, YJM Games holds a custom discount for other VR games including Kart Chaser: The Boost VR!

Check out all the games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=YJM%20GAMES]here[/url]!

notes.title: UPDATE NOTICE (PC only available!)- 2017/02/28
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The latest version of Kart Chaser: The Boost VR is now available.

[b]We are excited to announce that the long awaited moment for non-VR gamers has arrived. 
In this new version, you can experience Kart Chaser on your PC without VR devices![b/]

- If you want to play the PC version while your VR device is being connected, remove the VR device first and restart the game.
- Want to play the VR version? Simply connect your VR device and restart the game! Easy :)

Thank you for all the feedbacks and comments you sent us. We really appreciate it and we are doing our best to provide you the best gaming experience while playing Kart Chaser.

notes.title: UPDATE NOTICE (2017.02.03)
notes.content:
[b]Hi all![/b]

Thank you for enjoying KART-CHASER. 
Here is the list of today’s update!

1. The display of result UI that was hidden behind the map object has been fixed.
2. The effect of the shield has been improved (now the shield can block the missiles, hammers, water bomb, lightning, and UFO attacks)
3. Improved the glowing effect of STAR objects in the game.
4. Fixed the display of the item icon appearing incorrectly when returned to the game from pause state.
5. BGM sound gets smaller when press START button to pause the game.
6. The volume of BGM and SOUND FX can be adjusted in OPTION 
7. The BGM is gradually getting louder from 0 when entering the track.
8. Fixed the situation that the kart is falling off the map in some tracks.
9. Pause cannot be activated after you reached to the finish-line.
